punchline: A 24-jam table drew more shoppers, but a 6-jam table got far more of them to buy.
thirty_sec: In a market tasting test, shoppers saw either 24 jams or 6. The big display stopped more people, but among those who stopped, far more bought after seeing 6. Barry Schwartz uses this to argue that more options do not always bring more freedom, though later studies have not always repeated the effect.
